title: Waymo Says Recall Prompted By 11 New Incidents of Robotaxis Entering Closed Freeway Lanes - Slashdot

content_html: Charlotte Web writes: CNBC is reporting that Waymo recalled its robotaxis after 11 incidents of robotaxis entering closed freeway lanes in the last 8 weeks, including three times on a single day this month. ["Waymo told the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration in a filing released Tuesday that three Waymo vehicles entered freeway lanes marked with cones as closed for construction on Nov. 9, just three days after the company 'updated the approved scope of operation to reduce exposure to closed freeway lanes,'" reports CNBC. The company says it's still working on the recall remedy.] The article also notes America's NHTSA and the National Transportation Safety Board "have opened probes after one of Waymo's self-driving vehicles struck a child who ran into a street in Santa Monica, California." Last week, Waymo halted operations on U.S. freeways after a California regulator barred its vehicles from freeways in the state. According to the California Department of Motor Vehicles, the ban resulted from a series of incidents in which Waymo robotaxis entered active construction zones.
